MUSIC AND DANCE — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)

   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.

9. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Western Ensembles.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.

10. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.

11. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
